thread:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: incidentbot healthcheck failing — no outgoing pages to pagerflow for 8m. service=incidentbot env=prod. triggered=2026-03-17T16:12:30Z

sre-jen: oncall here. seeing the same in grafana. can someone verify pagerflow endpoint 502s?

ops-matt: i'm able to curl /health -> 200, but /send returns 504s intermittently. logs: ```2026-03-17T16:10:12Z ERROR send_request timeout to pagerflow gateway```

eng-platform-lee: looks like incidentbot's http client started returning 503 after connection pool saturation post-rotation. pushing a quick restart to prod now. i'll restart canary first then prod if green.

sre-jen: do we need to page the oncall by phone while automation is flaky? @kevin-sales FYI for customer impact.

kevin-sales: thanks — i've got a customer on the line asking why they didn't get a page. will triage with CS after we stabilize. estimate <10 affected users/clusters.

monitoring-bot: NOTE: auto-retry logic is disabled when healthcheck failure >5m (observed since deploy 2026-03-17T15:58).

eng-platform-lee: rolled restart on 2 canaries; send path is healthy on canaries. starting prod rolling restart (containers: incidentbot-*).

ops-matt: prod restart in flight. temporarily unmuting paging bridge and sending manual page to oncall list: `!page oncall --reason "incidentbot outage"`

oncall-dave: I got the manual page & voicemail. joining the call.

sre-jen: manual page confirmed. keeping automation disabled via feature flag until we observe stability for 30m.

eng-platform-lee: preliminary root cause: client library changed backoff behavior; under transient downstream errors this led to connection pool exhaustion. rolling back client lib in canary now.

ops-matt: mitigations applied: increased http client connection pool, restarted queue workers, re-enabled retries behind a circuit-breaker with 10s backoff. playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/incbot-fallback

kevin-sales: CS update: notified affected customers, offered manual workarounds and temporary paging via SMS relay. will coordinate comms after postmortem.

sre-jen: severity bumped to P1 for the duration because paging is primary alert channel. Incident owner: eng-platform-lee. time opened: 8132467890

eng-platform-lee: send path now stable across regions. will monitor for 45m before re-enabling automation. added regression test in CI to catch backoff regressions.

monitoring-bot: RECOVERY: incidentbot send queue healthy. outgoing page success rate restored to 99.9%.

sre-jen: closing live mitigation. please file a postmortem and link it here. owner: eng-platform-lee. tags: [paging, incidentbot, pagerflow, regression]
